name: ks-tomato-trails-2026
description: Deployment scripts for K's Tomato Trails 2026 tracker pages

scripts.build:tracker: python3 scripts/build_experiment_trails_page.py && python3 scripts/build_tomato_pot_mapping.py --no-strict && python3 scripts/build_tomato_trails_page.py && python3 scripts/build_pot_intake_history_page.py && python3 scripts/build_pot_run_comparison_page.py && python3 scripts/build_hard_row_reviewer_page.py && python3 scripts/build_non_tomato_snapshot_page.py && python3 scripts/build_experiment_trails_label_editor_page.py && python3 scripts/build_new_batch_reviewer_page.py && python3 scripts/build_sw1_ground_truth_reviewer_page.py && python3 scripts/build_v14_cv_research_page.py && python3 scripts/build_version_archive_page.py
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:tracker && npx wrangler pages deploy tracker --project-name ks-tomato-trails-2026 --branch master --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run build:tracker && npx wrangler pages deploy tracker --project-name ks-tomato-trails-2026 --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
